kitchen_name.description: Name for the kitchen ticket. Empty = uses `name` (Toast's rule).

price.description: The CLOSED price, in the whole unit of the money contract.

tax_category_key.description: The rate of the single line when supply_kind is `service`. Mandatory in that case: a single-supply combo with no rate of its own cannot be billed.

supply_kind.description: `service` = single supply, ONE line at tax_category_key (art. 91.Uno.2.2 LIVA: hospitality served on the premises is 10%, the wine included). `goods` = supply of goods of diverse nature, the closed price apportioned into ONE LINE PER COMPONENT (art. 79.Dos LIVA). The business declares it; the till never guesses it.
